title: The Lies of Locke Lamora
author: Scott Lynch
review: Who doesn't love a heist? Perfectly put together story that keeps you guessing and caring about the characters. The audiobook narration is perfection; Michael Page's inflection of characters pretending to be other characters has to be heard to be believed. Just on a completely otherworldly level narration-wise. Also, the story is self contained even though this is a series, so you don't feel obligated to keep going and can take a break.

highlights.text: It is one thing to kill in a duel, to kill in self-defense, to kill for vengeance. It is another thing entirely to kill simply because you are careless.
“When you do, those poor idiots won’t have any idea that they’re really dining with a thief.”
